From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@northstarpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-15T15:12:00Z
Subject: Vendr profile curation sprint + evidence handoff

Hi Amit / Lara —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. As discussed, we want to do a focused profile curation sprint in Vendr to tidy up field mappings, refresh the SIG answers tied to your SOC 2 attestations, and attach a concise evidence manifest so your procurement team can sign off quickly. Proposed plan below: 

• Week 0 (today): Invite & scope — we grant portal access and ask for the latest SOC 2 cert + vuln summary.
• Week 1: Field curation pass — we standardize the CAIQ-derived fields and mark any vendor-only caveats.
• Week 2: Evidence crawl & handoff — we upload short proofs (scan summary, attestation) and export the manifest for your procurement.

Quick asks for your side: 
1) Can you confirm the primary contact for evidence uploads (email to invite is referenced above)?
2) Any additional documents beyond SOC 2 and the vuln summary we should expect?

I attached a starter SIG template and a blank evidence manifest CSV for your convenience. If this schedule works, I’ll create a short runbook with assigned owners (internal + your contact).

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Vendor Security — Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0173

From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@northstarpay.com>

Date: 2028-07-15T20:03:00Z

Thanks Camila — good summary. Lara and I reviewed and we can support the timeline. A few clarifications: 

• Primary uploader will be Lara (lara.bennett@northstarpay.com). She’ll need the Vendr invite sent to that address.
• We will provide last SOC 2 Type II (report.pdf) and a vuln scan executive summary (vuln-scan-summary.pdf).
• There is one outstanding compensating control we document in our POA&M — I can flag any SIG questions that touch it.

We’ll attach the SOC 2 and the vuln PDF to the Vendr profile once Lara has access. One ask from procurement: can you export the evidence manifest as CSV with a simple "possession" column and a link column we can populate with pre-signed S3 URLs? That format speeds approvals on our side.

Attaching the completed SIG template for the sections we can prefill.

—Amit

Thanks — tagging in operational details so we don’t block the sprint. Camila / Marissa: I can provision the Vendr invite today for Lara (using the email Amit confirmed). Two small notes: 

1) CSV manifest: we support a possession/link/status triple (possession, link, proof_status) — proof_status will be one of: uploaded / presigned_pending / external_link. We can export that directly from our upload tool.
2) For the compensating control Amit mentioned: please mark the related SIG question with an annotation ("comp_control: POAM-2028-07") so the audit trail preserves it.

If everyone agrees I’ll:
• Create the Vendr invite for Lara and add a one-line upload guide.
• Seed the manifest with CAIQ fields we’ll edit during the curation pass.

Marissa — can you take ownership of the curation checklist (mapping CAIQ -> Vendr fields) and run the pass with me next Tuesday?

Karthik
